channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Após 4º voto pela condenação de Eduardo Bolsonaro por difamação, Mendonça suspende julgamento
item.description: Minister André Mendonça requested a pause and interrupted the STF trial examining Eduardo Bolsonaro's defamation case against deputy Tabata Amaral. The request came after minister Cristiano Zanin followed rapporteur Alexandre de Moraes, resulting in a 4-0 vote in favor of Bolsonaro's condemnation.

item.title: PDT questiona no Supremo eleição que definiu Douglas Ruas como presidente da Alerj
item.description: The PDT filed an ADPF with the STF challenging the election of Douglas Ruas as president of the Alerj, which was conducted by open vote, arguing that the internal rule change permitting this format lacked proper legislative procedure. The party requests the annulment of the vote and a new secret ballot election, citing risks of undue external interference and violations of constitutional principles such as legislative autonomy, administrative morality, and democratic regime integrity.

item.title: Caso Ramagem: Lula diz esperar que EUA voltem a 'conversar' para que a relação volte à 'normalidade'
item.description: President Lula said he hopes the U.S. will resume dialogue to restore normal bilateral relations, following Brazil’s decision to revoke the work credentials of a U.S. official in response to the Trump administration’s action against PF delegate Andrei Rodrigues, who participated in the arrest of Alexandre Ramagem. The Brazilian Foreign Ministry stated the U.S. violated a cooperation agreement by acting without prior notice or dialogue, and confirmed Brazil will apply the principle of reciprocity.

item.title: Mendonça pede vista e adia julgamento contra Eduardo Bolsonaro
item.description: Minister André Mendonça requested a view and halted the STF trial of the defamation case filed by Tabata Amaral against Eduardo Bolsonaro. So far, four justices have voted for conviction, proposing a fine of approximately R$ 85,000. The case, concerning a 2021 post linking the deputy to Jorge Paulo Lemann, is suspended without a set date for resumption.

item.title: A reação de Lula à retirada de credenciais de agente dos EUA após caso Ramagem
item.description: President Lula praised the Federal Police's decision to revoke the credentials of a U.S. agent in retaliation for the U.S. sending back a Brazilian delegate involved in the Alexandre Ramage arrest, stressing reciprocity in international relations. He also announced the hiring of 1,000 new federal police officers to strengthen public security. The Itamaraty criticized the move as violating diplomatic best practices and lacking prior dialogue with the United States.

item.title: Governo Lula gastou R$350 milhões para alugar cruzeiros durante a COP30
item.description: The federal government spent R$350 million on cruise ship rentals to host delegations during COP30, held in Belém in November 2025, according to a document from the Civil House sent to the Chamber of Deputies. The expenditure was justified as necessary to address a shortage of hotel accommodations and local infrastructure to accommodate the large number of participants at the UN climate conference.

item.title: Valdemar encontra Eduardo nos EUA e diz estar confiante na escolha de André do Prado para o Senado
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto said he is confident André do Prado will be the PL's Senate candidate for São Paulo after meeting with Eduardo Bolsonaro in the U.S. Although Eduardo holds the final say, the PL has already unified behind André, who is seen as a loyal ally of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas and key in state legislative coordination. The decision comes amid right-wing divisions over avoiding ideological candidacies that could advantage the left.

item.title: Oposição busca impeachment de Gilmar Mendes e Dino propõe reforma do Judiciário
item.description: The opposition in the Chamber is seeking the impeachment of Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes after he requested the inclusion of former governor Romeu Zema in the fake news investigation. At the same time, Justice Flávio Dino proposed a judicial reform to restore public trust in the justice system.

item.title: Lula elogia retirada de credenciais de agente americano no Brasil: 'O que eles fizeram conosco, a gente vai fazer com eles'
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva praised the Federal Police for revoking the diplomatic credentials of a U.S. agent operating in Brazil, calling it a reciprocal measure after the U.S. requested the removal of Brazilian delegate Marcelo Ivo de Carvalho, who participated in the arrest of former deputy Alexandre Ramagem in the United States. Lula stated, 'What they did to us, we will do to them,' and expressed hope for renewed dialogue and normalization of bilateral relations. The move suspends the agent’s access to PF units and shared police databases, in line with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs’ criticism of the U.S. for failing to follow diplomatic best practices between friendly nations.

item.title: Flávio diz que Zema é vítima de militância do Judiciário e volta a acusar STF de interferência eleitoral
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) claims former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) is 'another victim of judicial militancy' and accuses the STF of interfering in the electoral process to imbalance the race. He reiterates criticism of the Supreme Federal Court, alleging its rulings favor opposing candidates.

item.title: PL deve apoiar PEC 6x1, mas quer novo regime de contratação e compensação
item.description: The PL, Brazil's main opposition party, signaled support for PEC 6x1, which aims to end the 6x1 work schedule — a key banner of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in the 2026 electoral year. However, the party demands a new hiring and compensation regime for affected workers. This move reflects an attempt to balance labor agendas with sectoral demands in a highly polarized electoral context.

item.title: Rede Sustentabilidade endossa candidatura de Marina ao Senado e chama Tarcísio de 'desastroso'
item.description: The São Paulo state executive of the Rede Sustentabilidade party endorsed Marina Silva's pre-candidacy for the Senate and harshly criticized Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, calling his administration 'disastrous'. The endorsement comes amid efforts to build alliances for the 2026 elections, focusing on environmental and sustainability agendas.

item.title: Zema sobre ser vice: 'O que existe são 3 candidaturas e vou levar a minha até o final'
item.description: Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and presidential pre-candidate for the Novo party, stated he was not officially approached by Flávio Bolsonaro to be his vice-presidential running mate. Despite the lack of an invitation, Zema affirmed he intends to maintain his presidential candidacy through the end of the 2026 elections, noting there are currently three candidacies in play.

item.title: Me comprometo com fim da moratória da Soja, diz Flávio Bolsonaro durante a agro Norte Show
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for President in 2026, defended ending the Soy Moratorium during the Agro Norte Show, stating his commitment to the measure. He argued that the agreement, which prohibits companies from buying soy produced in deforested areas of the Amazon, harms rural producers.

item.title: Flávio diz que espera ser “candidato do agro” como seu pai
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) said he hopes to be the 'agribusiness candidate' in the 2026 elections during the Norte Show in Sinop (MT), emphasizing the legacy of the Bolsonaro government for the sector. He stated that agribusiness grew under deregulated credit and lower interest rates, and that his visit aimed to listen to demands to formulate commitments for a more prosperous and internationally respected agribusiness.

item.title: 'Trabalho não pode separar mães e filhos', diz Lula em vídeo do PT por fim da 6x1
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) announced he will deliver a speech in a Workers' Party video, to be broadcast nationally starting this Thursday (23), advocating for the end of the 6x1 work schedule. He emphasized that work should not separate mothers from their children, framing the issue as a matter of family and social rights. The video is part of the PT's campaign to promote labor law reforms.

item.title: Confira a pauta de julgamentos do TSE desta quinta-feira (23)
item.description: The TSE is set to rule on 13 cases this Thursday (23), including the requirement for voter registration and polling stations in prison facilities, appeals regarding new elections for mayor and vice-mayor in Barroquinha (CE), triple lists for substitute judges in TRE-PE and a titular judge in TRE-PR, and a request from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to decentralize funds for property rentals abroad for the 2026 overseas elections.

item.title: Zema rebate Gilmar: “O Supremo é o incendiário do Brasil”
item.description: Minas Gerais Governor Romeu Zema strongly criticized Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes and the Federal Supreme Court, claiming the institution has shifted from being a 'firefighter' to an 'arsonist' of Brazil by worsening institutional crises. Zema rebutted Mendes’ remarks, arguing that the STF, once seen as a stabilizing force, now fuels political instability through perceived partisanship.

item.title: STF “está podre”, diz Romeu Zema
item.description: Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and 2026 presidential pre-candidate for Novo, said the STF "is rotten" after Minister Gilmar Mendes filed a criminal complaint against him over a 2025 satirical video using puppets of justices. Zema called the move an "attack on democracy" and claimed his freedom of expression is being suppressed, prompting opposition lawmakers to announce an impeachment bid against Mendes.

item.title: Mendonça suspende julgamento de Eduardo Bolsonaro por difamação a Tabata após 4 votos por condenação
item.description: Minister André Mendonça requested a suspension of the STF trial regarding the defamation case involving Eduardo Bolsonaro, after four ministers voted for his conviction. Ministers Cristiano Zanin, Alexandre de Moraes, Cármen Lúcia, and Flávio Dino ruled that Bolsonaro shared false content on social media, claiming Tabata Amaral financially benefited from Jorge Paulo Lemann by proposing the free sanitary pads distribution law. The proposed sentence by the rapporteur is one year of detention in an open regime and 39 day-fines, equivalent to approximately R$ 126,4 thousand.

item.title: CCJ aprova admissibilidade de propostas que acabam com escala 6x1
item.description: The Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ) of the Chamber of Deputies unanimously approved the admissibility of two constitutional amendment proposals (PECs) that would end the 6x1 work schedule, proposing a 36-hour weekly workweek. The proposals will now be analyzed by a special committee before going to the plenary, while President Lula sent a constitutional urgency bill to reduce the workweek to 40 hours, arguing that the executive proposal does not compete with the PECs under consideration.

item.title: André Mendonça suspende julgamento de ação de Tabata Amaral contra Eduardo Bolsonaro por difamação
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça requested a view, suspending the trial of the criminal defamation case against Eduardo Bolsonaro filed by Deputy Tabata Amaral. Prior to the suspension, four justices voted for conviction, proposing one year of detention and a fine exceeding R$ 80,000. Relator Justice Alexandre de Moraes ruled that the offense occurred via social media and was motivated by the victim’s public office.

item.title: Zema reforça críticas ao STF após reação de Gilmar e diz que tribunal é incendiário
item.description: Presidential candidate from the Novo party and former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema harshly criticized the STF, calling it the 'worst Supreme Court in history' following a reaction from Justice Gilmar Mendes. He labeled the tribunal 'incendiary', reinforcing his confrontational stance toward the Judiciary.

item.title: Flávio se coloca como ‘candidato do agro’ e se diz solidário a Zema por inclusão no inquérito das fakenews
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) positioned himself as the agribusiness candidate during a visit to a fair in Mato Grosso, emphasizing his father's policies on rural credit and deregulation and urging the sector to 'repay' with votes. He also expressed solidarity with Romeu Zema (NOVO-MG), who was included in the fake news inquiry, accusing the judiciary of attempting to interfere in the election and citing Minister Alexandre de Moraes as an example of judicial activism.

item.title: Mendonça pede vista e interrompe julgamento que pode condenar Eduardo Bolsonaro
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça requested a view and interrupted the trial that could convict former deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro for defamation against Deputy Tabata Amaral. Before the suspension, four justices had already voted for conviction, including rapporteur Alexandre de Moraes, Cármen Lúcia, Flávio Dino and Cristiano Zanin. The case stems from Bolsonaro’s 2021 accusations that Tabata acted to benefit P&G illicitly through a sanitary pads distribution bill.

item.title: ‘O que existe são 3 candidaturas e vou levar a minha até o final’, diz Zema sobre ser vice de Flávio
item.description: Former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) stated he was not formally approached by Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) to be his running mate, but intends to maintain his presidential candidacy until the end, citing three right-wing pre-candidates: himself, Bolsonaro, and Caiado. He argues that a fragmented right-wing field weakens the left, which currently relies almost entirely on Lula, and points to Chile as an example where a fragmented right first round led to a far-right victory. Zema also said Jair Bolsonaro endorses the idea that more right-wing candidates strengthen the bloc.

item.title: Gilmar defende reforma sugerida por Dino, mas cobra 'pacto mais amplo': 'Quando aperta, todos correm lá para o Supremo'
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes endorsed the judicial reform proposal by colleague Flávio Dino but urged a broader pact involving the Executive and Legislative branches, noting that in times of pressure, everyone turns to the Supreme Court. He acknowledged the need to revise judicial benefits, such as 'penduricalhos,' and stressed that reform should not fall solely on the Judiciary, extending to administrative and legislative spheres.

item.title: Oposição pede impeachment de Gilmar Mendes por propor inclusão de Zema em inquérito das fake news
item.description: The opposition in the Chamber of Deputies filed an impeachment request against Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes after he sought to include former governor Romeu Zema in the fake news inquiry, citing a satirical video Zema published that mocked Supreme Court decisions. Opposition leader Cabo Gilberto Silva said the request had been in preparation due to the escalating conflict between Mendes and Zema, a pre-candidate for president, and noted that Flávio Bolsonaro did not attend the press conference due to other commitments. Zema defended the video as an exercise of free speech and political humor, stating the episode shows the 'shoe fit' the ministers.

item.title: Filha de Roberto Jefferson se filia ao DC e pode disputar eleição
item.description: Cristiane Brasil, daughter of former deputy Roberto Jefferson, has joined the Christian Democracy Party (DC), which has Aldo Rebelo as its presidential candidate for 2026. Her affiliation increases her prospects of running for an elected office in the upcoming elections, though the specific position has not yet been determined.

item.title: Mendonça interrompe julgamento que pode condenar Eduardo Bolsonaro
item.description: Minister André Mendonça requested a review and halted the STF trial that could have convicted Eduardo Bolsonaro for defamation against Deputy Tabata Amaral. Four justices had already voted to condemn him to one year in open regime, arguing he falsely implied Amaral sought to benefit a businessman when introducing a bill. Mendonça now has up to 90 days to return the case.

item.title: Mendonça pede vista e suspende julgamento no STF sobre condenação de Eduardo Bolsonaro por difamação contra Tabata
item.description: Minister André Mendonça requested a view and suspended the STF trial on the criminal action that could convict Eduardo Bolsonaro to one year in detention for defamation against federal deputy Tabata Amaral. Before the suspension, four justices had already voted in favor of conviction, following the rapporteur Alexandre de Moraes, who deemed the crime of defamation proven based on posts attributing to Tabata the intent to illicitly benefit third parties via her bill on public distribution of sanitary pads.

item.title: Ronaldo Caiado escolhe ex-ministro de FHC Roberto Brant para formular plano de governo
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, the PSD's presidential pre-candidate, appointed former minister Roberto Brant as coordinator of his government plan for the electoral campaign. Caiado praised Brant's intellectual independence and ability to synthesize contributions, noting his tenure as Minister of Social Security under Fernando Henrique Cardoso and his current unaffiliated status.

item.title: Código de Fachin e reforma de Dino instalam guerra fria no STF
item.description: Supreme Court President Edson Fachin is pushing for an ethics code to be approved by year-end but faces resistance, even from allies, with only Carmen Lúcia fully supporting the proposal. The effort has been complicated by Flávio Dino’s judicial reform initiative, which opposes the code and indirectly criticizes Fachin. Key sensitivities include disclosure of agendas, ministers’ side incomes, and contracts of ministers’ children who work as lawyers, deepening divisions within the Court.

item.title: PT aciona TSE por vídeo de Flávio Bolsonaro contra Lula
item.description: The campaign of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva filed a request with the TSE to remove a video posted by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) on Instagram, which has surpassed 1.6 million views. The video combines clips of Lula’s interviews with statements from former minister Antônio Palocci related to Operation Car Wash. The legal action claims the content is taken out of context and aims to defame the president.

item.title: A firme fala de Elisa Lucinda para Juliano Cazarré em evento de homens
item.description: Elisa Lucinda criticized the 'Forja' event, created by Juliano Cazarré for 'fragile' men, calling it a 'great and worrying delusion'. She argued that Jesus was left-leaning and that policies like Bolsa Família align more with Christian teachings than conservative stances or support for figures like Donald Trump. The controversy highlights ongoing debates in Brazil about religion, politics, and masculinity.

item.title: Campanha de Lula pede retirada de vídeo publicado por Flávio que associa presidente à corrupção
item.description: Lula's legal team has requested the TSE to remove a video posted by Flávio Bolsonaro that associates the president with corruption schemes. The request was made through Bolsonaro's pre-campaign, citing defamation and misuse of image. The video, published on April 22, 2026, was deemed by Lula's campaign as an attempt to discredit the president with unfounded allegations.

item.title: O plano de SP para reduzir pela metade as mortes no trânsito até 2030
item.description: The São Paulo state government established the State Road Safety Plan (PSV-SP) through Decree 70.551, signed by Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, aiming to cut traffic fatalities by half by 2030. The ten-year policy was published in the Official Gazette on Wednesday, the 22nd. The initiative focuses on integrated actions in prevention, enforcement, and infrastructure to improve road safety across the state.

item.title: PF retalia EUA e tira credenciais de agente norte-americano no Brasil
item.description: The Federal Police revoked the credentials of a U.S. agent in Brazil as a reciprocal measure, following U.S. requests for the removal of Brazilian delegate Marcelo Ivo de Carvalho, an ICE liaison officer. The Lula government says it received no official communication from Washington and frames the move as a response to external pressure, while the PF stresses the restriction applies only to its premises and systems. The Itamaraty summoned the U.S. embassy for explanations, but no formal expulsion of the Brazilian official was confirmed.

item.title: Danilo Gentili provoca Flávio Bolsonaro: ‘cite três coisas’
item.description: Comedian Danilo Gentili provoked Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a 2026 presidential candidate, asking him to name three positive contributions he made to society while being publicly funded. The remark is part of a broader pattern of criticism by Gentili toward members of the Bolsonaro family, including Carlos and Eduardo Bolsonaro, as well as former President Jair Bolsonaro, over their political statements and actions.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro viaja ao MT com camiseta “o agro é top!”
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president in 2026, visited the Norte Show in Sinop (MT) wearing a t-shirt that reads 'agro is top!', reinforcing his alignment with the agribusiness sector. He attended the fair's opening alongside allies such as Senator Wellington Fagundes (PL-MT) and former minister Rogério Marinho (PL-RN), at an event projected to draw over 130,000 visitors and generate R$4 billion in business, as seen in the previous edition.

item.title: Deputados pedem impeachment de ministro de Lula
item.description: Federal Deputy Helio Lopes (PL-RJ) filed an impeachment request against Minister of Justice Wellington César Lima e Silva for alleged responsibility crime. The accusation stems from the alleged expulsion of a Federal Police delegate from the United States, based on information from the Western Hemisphere Affairs Department.

item.title: Rede Sustentabilidade de SP manifesta apoio à candidatura de Marina ao Senado
item.description: The São Paulo chapter of Rede Sustentabilidade has declared its support for Marina Silva's pre-candidacy for the Federal Senate and for Fernando Haddad's candidacy for state government. The party described Marina as "one of Brazil's and the world's greatest ethical and political references" in a social media announcement.

item.title: PT pede urgência para PL que barra anistia a Bolsonaro
item.description: The government coalition in the Chamber of Deputies filed an urgency request to vote on a bill that classifies crimes against the Democratic State of Law as heinous and blocks any form of amnesty, even partial, for former President Jair Bolsonaro. The proposal aims to prevent him from benefiting from amnesties in cases related to the January 8 attacks.

item.title: CCJ da Câmara aprova proposta que acaba com a escala 6×1
item.description: The Chamber's Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ) approved, in a symbolic vote, a favorable opinion on a PEC to end the 6×1 work schedule, presented by Deputy Paulo Azi (União-BA), which also evaluates PECs from Erika Hilton (PSOL-SP) and Reginaldo Lopes (PT-MG). The proposal now moves to a special committee before plenary vote, while the Lula government seeks to accelerate debate via a constitutional urgency bill to reduce the workweek to 40 hours.

item.title: Comissão da Câmara aprova PEC do fim da escala 6x1 em meio a disputa entre Congresso e governo
item.description: The Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ) of the Chamber of Deputies approved the admissibility of a PEC proposing the end of the 6x1 work schedule, advancing to the creation of a special committee to debate the proposal’s merits. Rapporteur Deputy Paulo Azi (União Brasil-BA) advocated for a transition phase and compensation for productive sectors, while discussions point toward a possible compromise of a 40-hour weekly workweek and a 5x2 schedule, aligned with the federal government’s proposal. The approval comes under pressure from the Executive, which submitted a bill with constitutional urgency to speed up the process.

item.title: Em meio a briga interna, diretório da Rede em SP anuncia apoio a candidatura de Marina ao Senado
item.description: The São Paulo state directory of the Rede Sustentabilidade announced support for Marina Silva’s Senate candidacy, highlighting her ethical leadership and commitment to sustainability amid internal party conflict with the national leadership, which accused her of undermining collective decisions. The party also reaffirmed its backing for Fernando Haddad’s gubernatorial re-election and Lula’s democratic project.

item.title: Zema publicou 14 vídeos com críticas ao STF nesta semana
item.description: Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and presidential pre-candidate, posted 14 videos criticizing the Supreme Federal Court (STF) in one week after Justice Gilmar Mendes requested his inclusion in the fake news inquiry. He labeled the justices 'Untouchables' and compared the Court to colonial authorities, claiming the inquiry is a tool to persecute opponents under a veneer of legality. Zema vowed not to be silenced and defended his satire as legitimate democratic expression.

item.title: PF quer mais tempo para concluir investigação contra Monark
item.description: The Federal Police requested Minister Alexandre de Moraes of the STF to extend the deadline to conclude an investigation against influencer Monark for alleged disobedience to judicial decisions. The PF cited technical limitations in the STF’s system that prevented full analysis of files within the initial 30-day period, but stated the team is now aligned and in an advanced phase of work. The investigation began after the January 8, 2023 attacks, when Monark’s profiles were blocked for allegedly inciting the coup attempts.

item.title: Mais de 175 mil brasileiros com deficiência de locomoção votam em seções sem acessibilidade
item.description: Over 175,000 Brazilian voters with mobility disabilities are registered in polling stations lacking accessibility, accounting for 37.1% of the 471,000 such voters nationwide, according to TSE data. In Mato Grosso and Alagoas, the rate exceeds 90%, with Mato Grosso reaching 94.6% of disabled voters in inaccessible locations. Despite the TSE’s stated commitment to improving accessibility, the deadline to transfer voter titles to accessible sections is May 6, 2025.

item.title: Governo pede e relator adia parecer sobre marco dos minerais críticos
item.description: Relator Arnaldo Jardim postponed the report on the Critical Minerals Regulatory Framework at the request of the Lula government, which seeks to include the creation of the state-owned Terrabras and export restrictions. This is the second delay, with the report now set for May 4, amid remote voting sessions and ongoing negotiations among ministries and the Civil House to establish centralized governance.
